decisions.statement: A subagent is held where its page names this seat and a stop is written beside that page.
A subagent of another seat is held by nothing here.
A subagent is held by the id the subagent runs under rather than by its whole agent id.
A page stating no agent id holds nothing.
The set is read whole from the pages at the start.
The set is read whole again after a change under a subagent page's folder settles.
The set is read whole again after a subagent page's folder appears or goes.
A subagent page whose folder came after the start is followed once that folder appears.
Asking whether a subagent is held reads no file.
A subagent once held stays held for the life of this gateway.
A subagent whose page has gone stays held, so a stop outlives its page.
A refused turn asks the take-down for that subagent's page.
The page of one subagent is asked for once however many turns are refused.
A seat no name is read for asks for no page.
An index that will not answer leaves the turn refused and asks for no page.
The take-down is handed in so a test spawns nothing.
Stopping the following closes every watcher.
The pages read are handed in so a test needs no index.
Nothing here answers a request.
Nothing proves a folder that came after the start is followed, against a folder really watched.

definition: the subagents a gateway holds as stopped, read from the pages beside its seat and followed
